text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Yes, Mother. The arrangements for the "Founding Anniversary Party" are proceeding smoothly. As the organizer, I will surely lead it to success.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Overthinking—I have studied methods for correcting cognitive bias. All that remains is to put it into practice in daily life, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Hayahide~! I've been looking all over for you~!
There's something I want you to join in on~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I see, a three-player survival horror game.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
With me, Turbo, and you on the team,
it's definitely gonna go super well~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Teio! Hayahide! Hurry up~!
Turbo's already inside the Umulator!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ( ...Hmm, this may serve as the perfect training exercise to eliminate cognitive distortions.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The gun's energy has fallen below half. I shall prepare a recharge item on hand. No, one more backup just to be safe—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ( Ngh, no, this won't do... I must correct my cognitive bias and dispel unnecessary anxieties—)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide, you still have that many items left!?
I used up all of mine during that enemy rush
just now~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ! ...If you like, I can spare a few for you. The journey ahead still seems long, after all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: This is... the mansion master's diary? It appears to be purely personal content, but... No, I should peruse it just in case.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "Enticed by the warm early summer weather today, I took a stroll in the garden with my wife, Mary—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, this is bad. I let myself get distracted by trivialities in the name of caution. I must hurry so I don't fall behind the two of them...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "To open the door, enter the name of the one I love"?! How is Turbo supposed to know that!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ! Turbo-kun, regarding that, the diary I read earlier mentioned—

text_block_list.name: Boss Monster
text_block_list.text: GGYAAAAAAHHHH...!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
We did it! Boss defeated!
We cleared the game!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Do not lower your guard.
Teio-kun, distance yourself from that boss immediately.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it stood back up...!?
Could that be... its second form or something~!?

text_block_list.name: Boss Monster
text_block_list.text:
GGYAAAAHH...
Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmph, did you think you could deceive us by concealing your true abilities? However—compared to the enemies thus far, you went down far too easily.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Becoming intoxicated by the audacity of your plan, and lacking prudence in its execution. That is the cause of your defeat.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Analysis complete. Our victory and your defeat are sealed. Now, it is time for the proof—!

text_block_list.name: Boss Monster
text_block_list.text: GGYAAAAAAAHHHH...!!

text_block_list.name: Teio & Turbo
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAAAYYYYYYY!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's engine was running at full throttle too,
but Hayahide, you were incredible!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! My intuition was spot on!
Hayahide's attentiveness is a natural-born weapon!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, thank you.
I learned quite a lot myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking around the academy, I spotted Biwa Hayahide looking quite busy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: My family's liquor store is holding its "Founding Anniversary Party" soon. My parents entrusted me with organizing the event.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It is an important annual tradition where we invite neighbors, relatives, and friends.
choice_data_list: Sounds like a great chance to have fun together!
Sounds like a great chance for everyone to have fun!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It is an important annual tradition where we invite neighbors, relatives, and friends.
choice_data_list: Sounds like a great chance to have fun together!
Sounds like a great chance for everyone to have fun!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Indeed! I must ensure it is a party that brings a smile to everyone's face.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, that reminds me—would you like to attend as well?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Of course. Aside from Taishin and Ticket, I have invited many people from the academy as well. I am certain you will enjoy yourself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes, naturally. There are no oversights whatsoever. From ordering drink and food menus tailored to the expected attendance, time of day, and weather conditions—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: To devising a seating arrangement that balances personalities, ages, acquaintances, and first-time encounters to facilitate lively conversation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I simply want everyone to enjoy themselves as much as possible. If you are willing, please do join us.
